question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Indoulgent"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Indulgent"**. (सहनशील या लाड़-प्यार करने वाला)

 

 
• **Example: **The indulgent mother allowed her child to eat as many sweets as he wanted.

 

 

 
• The word **"Indoulgent"** does not exist in the English language and appears to be a typographical or spelling error.

 
• The correct word **"Indulgent"** means having or indicating a tendency to be overly generous or lenient with someone. (लाड़-प्यार करने वाला)

 

 
• **Example: **Grandparents are often indulgent towards their grandchildren, spoiling them with gifts and treats.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__

 
• **Happiness **(खुशी): The state of being happy or feeling joy.

 

 
• **Example:** True happiness comes from within, not from material possessions.

 

 

 
• **Veneration **(श्रद्धा): Great respect or reverence for someone or something.

 

 
• **Example: **The veneration of elders is an important value in many cultures.

 

 

 
• **Forgotten** (भूल गया): Something that is no longer remembered or brought to mind.

 

 
• **Example:** The once-famous author has now been forgotten by most readers.
